Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Ruston for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from artificial ice skating at the Ruston Sports Complex (November 30) through December 17, with the Christmas Train in downtown Ruston (December 2), the Ruston Christmas Parade (December 3), Lincoln Lights Up the Pines (December 3 to 12), Pictures with Santa and Christmas in the Village in Choudrant (both December 5) and the Christmas Cookie Crawl (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Ruston

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Ruston
  • 2 free events: the Ruston Christmas Parade and Pictures with Santa at the Historic Fire Station
  • Meet Santa: Pictures with Santa (December 5), Christmas on the Farm at the OWL Center in Dubach (December 5) and cookies with Santa at Christmas in the Village in Choudrant (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Ruston Christmas Parade (December 3) and the Choudrant parade (December 5)
  • Trains: the Christmas Train in downtown Ruston (December 2)
  • Season: November 30 to December 17

Planning a bigger day out? Ruston families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Shreveport, which covers the city's holiday lights, parades, shows and Santa visits.
